name: De Slimste Mens ter Wereld
description: Do we still sing the praises of folly like Erasmus, or is it trendy again to be smart? And if so, who is the smartest? Who can talk about the medals won at the Olympic Games in London, but at the same time knows who Captain Haddock is? Who knows whether Lacan was a hair growth product or a psychoanalyst and can also program their own digital television? Who has déjà vu when leafing through the Encyclopedia Britannica and when reading the interviews with the new Miss Waregem Koerse?  Who, oh who, is the smartest person in Flanders, Belgium, Europe, and by extension, the world? That is determined by a fierce battle between three fellow human beings. Every day, someone is eliminated, someone who may not be the smartest, but who is perhaps cherished in their family circle because of their many other talents. The others advance and are joined by a new challenger every day.

videos.title: Episode 7

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Young acting talent in the studio tonight: 23-year-old Ayana Doucouré, who made her breakthrough in Flanders with the role of Margaux in “Knokke off”. On the jury: Daan Alferink and Jeroom.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: New candidate: former colonel and defence expert Roger Housen. Anastasya Chernook and William Boeva are members of the jury.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Tonight, 26-year-old actress, radio presenter at MNM and podcast host Charlotte Sieben will be making her debut. Charlotte's colleague and good friend Manu Van Acker and Jennifer Heylen will be serving as judges.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: The 29-year-old dancer, writer and actress Nora Monsecour joins the show tonight as a new candidate. On the jury: Jonas Geirnaert and Lieven Scheire.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Tonight, 27-year-old rapper Mohamed Eddahbi Agounad, better known as DIKKE, will make his debut. Alex Agnew and Tine Embrechts will serve as judges.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Tonight, Dorien Nuyts (30), Antwerp's most famous chip shop owner and a TikTok and Instagram hit, will be joining the show. Jonas Geirnaert and Soundos El Ahmadi will be on the judging panel.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Arno The Kid will be joining us tonight. The 26-year-old YouTuber can hardly do worse than his older brother Average Rob, who was eliminated from the game after just one episode two years ago. Jeroom and Wim Helsen will be on the jury.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Tonight, “Real Housewife of Antwerp” Annelies Schetters makes her entrance as a candidate.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Tonight, stand-up comedian Michael Van Peel (47) will be making his debut. Judges: Bart Cannaerts and Alex Agnew.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Dutch comedian and performance artist Gover Meit appeared on the jury last year and shaved off his moustache, but now he is joining as a candidate. Bart Cannaerts and Jade Mintjens are the chosen jury members.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Actress Ini Massez (49), who appeared in Knokke off and just about every other top Flemish series in recent years, makes her entrance. Jury: Bockie De Repper and Steven Van Herreweghe.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: The 24-year-old singer Kaat Van Stralen, winner of Studio Brussel's 'De nieuwe lichting' (The New Generation), will be entering the quiz arena tonight. The judges on duty are Jennifer Heylen and Daan Alferink.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Tonight, 43-year-old comedian Yannick Noben from Limburg will make his entrance. The jury will be composed of Sven de Leijer and William Boeva.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Today, the versatile musician and singer Billie Leyers joins the programme. Herman Brusselmans and her older sister Ella Leyers are members of the jury.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Tonight, 27-year-old radio host Imane Boudadi (MNM Ochtendshow) will make her appearance in the studio. Jeroom and James Cooke are on duty as jury members.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Sports journalist and radio host Ruben Van Gucht (38) makes his entrance. He previously participated in 2016, but was eliminated after just one episode. Tonight's jury consists of two Dutch personalities: cabaret artist Marc-Marie Huijbregts and stand-up comedian, presenter, and actor Edson da Graça.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: The stylish 30-year-old lawyer Davina Simons tries her luck in the quiz arena. The jury members are Jonas Geirnaert and Barbara Sarafian.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Cyclist Wout van Aert joins the panel. Will he immediately drop the competition? Alex Agnew and Soundos are the serving jury members.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Stand-up comedian and presenter Jens Dendoncker appears on the scene. The jury is formed by Sven De Leijer and Lieven Scheire.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Podcast creator, YouTuber, and Studio Brussel personality Nona Van Braeckel will be joining us for tonight's quiz. Jeroom and Jonas Geirnaert will be sitting at the judges' desk.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Actor Jean Janssens joins as a new candidate. James Cooke and Herman Brusselmans sit in the jury.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Today, 29-year-old actress Emma Moortgat joins the program, known for her roles in “Dertigers” and “Knokke off”. Daphne Agten and William Boeva are the members of the jury.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Tonight, 28-year-old influencer and content creator Elodie Gabias will be joining us. Wim Helsen and Ella Leyers are the judges on duty.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Tonight, the 28-year-old Antwerp rapper Miss Angel, who in real life goes by the name Angela Agyei, makes her entrance. Alex Agnew and Bockie De Repper are at the jury's desk.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Roel Steeno is the final candidate of the week. This 51-year-old actor and comedian has been the regular audience-warmer of 'De Slimste Mens' for years. Now he's taking his own shot. The jury consists of Bart Cannaerts and Jennifer Heylen.

videos.title: Finale week
videos.overview: The final weeks are starting. The eight best candidates of this season return to the game and compete for the final victory. Tonight, comedian Michael Van Peel (4 episodes - 1 win) and 'frituur' owner Dorien Nuyts (5 episodes - 1 win) will take their seats again. Jury: Jade Mintjens and Manu Van Acker.

videos.title: Finale week
videos.overview: Tonight, sports journalist Ruben Van Gucht returns to the game. He survived five episodes and won one. The jury consists of James Cooke and Guga Baúl.

videos.title: Finale week
videos.overview: Comedian and VTM presenter Jens Dendoncker is making his return to the studio. He lasted five episodes and won two of them. The serving jury members are Philippe Geubels and Francis van Broekhuizen.

videos.title: Finale week
videos.overview: In the concluding episode of the first final week, Erik once again welcomes 27-year-old MNM radio presenter Imane Boudadi (5 episodes, 2 wins). Bart Cannaerts and Daan Alferink make up the jury.
